_comment: Reusable icon library for the DataArt Corporate Slides Kit. 35 line icons, 44x44 viewBox, 2px stroke, two-tone (#000000 ink + #3453AD Blue400 accent) — already on-brand, no recolouring needed. Drop into any .icon-block / .pipe / numbered-icon-card slot via . Picked for software-engineering / IT-consulting decks. 'use' = when to reach for it during deck assembly.
